+# Resolve the installed relay config without exposing credentials.
+RELAY_ROOT="$HOME/Library/Application Support/SysGridRelay"
+CONFIG_PATH="$(python3 - <<'PY2' "$RELAY_ROOT"
+import json, pathlib, sys
+root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
+seen={}
+for p in root.rglob('*.json') if root.exists() else []:
+    try: d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+    except Exception: continue
+    if not isinstance(d, dict): continue
+    if d.get('repository')!='kimhw8084/system_grid' or d.get('workflow')!='sysgrid-public-outbox-relay.yml': continue
+    keys=('control_root','state_path','spool_root','gh_path','token_path','repository','workflow')
+    if not all(d.get(k) for k in ('control_root','state_path','gh_path','token_path')): continue
+    key=tuple(str(d.get(k,'')) for k in keys)
+    seen.setdefault(key,[]).append(p)
+if len(seen)!=1:
+    raise SystemExit(f'expected one unique active relay config, found {len(seen)}')
+paths=next(iter(seen.values()))
+paths.sort(key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
+print(paths[0])
+PY2
+)" || fail "unable to resolve unique relay config"

+# Final authority checks. The EXIT trap restores the temporary verify-app patch atomically.
+require_eq "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$COMMIT" "final local HEAD"
+require_eq "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" "$COMMIT" "final origin/main"
+require_eq "$(sha256_file "$BRIDGE_PATH")" "$TARGET_BRIDGE_SHA" "final bridge"
+require_eq "$(sha256_file "$WORKFLOW_PATH")" "$TARGET_WORKFLOW_SHA" "final workflow"
+require_eq "$(sha256_file "$VERIFIER_PATH")" "$ACCEPTED_VERIFIER_SHA" "final accepted verifier"
+for i in 0 1 2; do
+  require_eq "$(sha256_file "${PROTECTED_PATHS[$i]}")" "${PROTECTED_SHAS[$i]}" "final protected path ${PROTECTED_PATHS[$i]}"
+done
